exam_scheme.note: Gujarat Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) is conducted by the State Examination Board (SEB), Gandhinagar under the Right to Education Act and NCTE regulations. It comprises TET-1 for Primary Classes (1-5), TET-2 for Upper Primary Classes (6-8), and TAT for Secondary/Higher Secondary schools.

stages.stage_name: TET-1: Primary Teacher Eligibility Test (Classes 1 to 5)
stages.source_label: Education Department Government of Gujarat Resolution No. PRE/1111/711/K dated 08/10/2025 and SEB Notification

papers.paper_name: Child Development and Pedagogy (Reasoning, Logical Ability, Teacher Aptitude, Data Interpretation)
Environmental Studies (Science, Social Studies, Local Environment, Pedagogy)

stages.stage_name: TET-2: Upper Primary Teacher Eligibility Test (Classes 6 to 8)
stages.source_label: Education Department Government of Gujarat Resolution No. PRE/1111/711/K dated 08/10/2025 and SEB Notification

papers.paper_name: Section 1 (Common): Child Development & Pedagogy (25), Gujarati (25), English (25), General Knowledge & Current Affairs (25)
Section 2 (Subject Elective): Mathematics & Science OR Social Science OR Languages (Gujarati/Hindi/English/Sanskrit)

stages.stage_name: Teacher Aptitude Test (TAT - Secondary & Higher Secondary)
stages.source_label: State Examination Board Gujarat Notification for TAT-Secondary (TAT-S) & TAT-Higher Secondary (TAT-HS)

papers.paper_name: Prelims Examination: Objective Paper (Part 1: General Studies 100 marks; Part 2: Subject Content & Pedagogy 100 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying cutoff for admission to Mains Descriptive examination

papers.paper_name: Mains Examination: Descriptive Papers (Paper 1: Language Ability 100 marks; Paper 2: Subject Content & Methodology 100 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 60% aggregate for General category; 55% for reserved categories

competition_benchmarks.note: Official qualifying figures released by the State Examination Board Gandhinagar for Gujarat TET cycles.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 16 (calculated: estimated candidate pool ÷ announced vacancies)
years.source_label: Government of Gujarat Cabinet Resolution: Statewide teacher recruitment calendar announcing 24,700 positions across Government & Granted schools (7,600 for TET-2, 6,200 for TET-1, 7,500 for TAT-S/HS, 3,400 for Principals/Senior Teachers).

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 15.76% pass rate (37,450 qualified out of 2,37,700 appeared)
years.source_label: State Examination Board (SEB) official result release for TET-2 (Upper Primary) held on 23/04/2023: 2,37,700 candidates appeared; 37,450 candidates (15.76%) declared qualified.
